correctness.rationale: The neutral-letter collapse follows directly from the EACom identities once the stable syntactic semigroup is a monoid. The PSPACE upper bound extends the established transition-semigroup method with polynomial-space sequential powering for omega. The hardness reduction preserves logspace constructibility and forces a c,d commutation witness exactly in the one-missing-word branch.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The motivating 2026 paper introduces QEACom and proves O(log n) upper bounds plus PSPACE-completeness for constant circuit complexity, but does not state QEACom-membership complexity. Searches found classical aperiodicity and commutative-star-free literature but no equivalent QEACom membership theorem. The recent source leaves near-simultaneous risk.

value.rationale: The theorem settles the natural NFA decision problem for the newly introduced QEACom class, with hardness even under a neutral-letter promise, and yields an exact O(1)-versus-not-o(log n) jump inside an O(log n) envelope for neutral-letter QEACom languages.
